introduction.p: Use Figure2 to answer the following questions about Carls neighborhood.

statement.p: What are the coordinates of the bar?

solution.p: We have to move 3 units to the right, then 3 units down. So the coordinates are (3,-3)\text{.}

statement.p: What are the coordinates of the gas station?

solution.p: We have to move 2 units to the left, then 4 units down. So the coordinates are (-2,-4)\text{.}

statement.p: What are the coordinates of Carls house?

solution.p: We dont move at all to get to Carls house. That is, we move 0 units to the left/right, and then 0 units up/down. So the coordinates are (0,0)\text{.}
